title: The overview and the project's terminology
statement: The overview is formal: the project name, the elevator pitch, a description, and Terms and Vocabulary, so the words a team says every day are defined and linked to the code and stories that define them.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The overview's parts are the project name, the elevator pitch, a description (a short essay), and Terms and Vocabulary.
A term is a record with a name, a definition, and any aliases, and it references the stories it belongs to and the exact code that defines it, most often an enum value or a constant.
The links run both ways: from a term to its code and stories, and from a line of code or a story to the terms it defines.
Renaming the enum makes the term's code reference stale, which names exactly the term to update.
A comparison that adds an enum value or a constant no term references suggests, as growth rather than a requirement, that the change may have introduced new terminology to define.
